# Update Commandssvg image

Relevant source files

- [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md)
- [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml)

## Purpose and Scopesvg image

This page documents the five commands responsible for managing incremental updates to context files through a patch-based system. These commands enable version tracking, differential updates, and synchronization workflows for both Markdown and HTML context files.

The update commands fall into two categories:

- **Patch Generation**: Create patch files by comparing two context file versions
- **Patch Application**: Apply patch files to update existing context files

For complete workflow examples including update operations, see [Version Control with Patches](/ray0404/Contexter/4.3-version-control-with-patches). For detailed documentation of individual commands, see subsections [5.3.1](/ray0404/Contexter/5.3.1-updatecontext) through [5.3.5](/ray0404/Contexter/5.3.5-updaterhtml).

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md20-35](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L20-L35) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py39-53](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L39-L53)

## Command Overviewsvg image

| Command | Module | Type | Format | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `updatecontext` | `update_context.py` | Generation | Markdown | Standard diff-based patch generation |
| `smartupdate` | `smart_update.py` | Generation | Markdown | Rsync-based patch generation (recommended) |
| `updatecontexthtml` | `update_context_html.py` | Generation | HTML | HTML context patch generation |
| `updater` | `updater.py` | Application | Markdown | Apply patches to Markdown contexts |
| `updaterhtml` | `updater_html.py` | Application | HTML | Apply patches to HTML contexts |

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py40-53](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L40-L53) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md27-33](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L27-L33)

## Two-Phase Update Workflowsvg image

**Diagram: Update Command Workflow**

The update system operates in two distinct phases:

1. **Generation Phase**: Compare two versions of a context file to produce a patch file that encodes the differences
2. **Application Phase**: Apply a patch file to a target context file to produce an updated version

This separation enables distributed workflows where patches can be generated on one machine, transferred, and applied on another.

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md27-33](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L27-L33)

## Command-to-Module Mappingsvg image

**Diagram: Update Commands Module Architecture**

Each CLI command corresponds to a single implementation module with a 1:1 mapping defined in [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py40-53](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L40-L53) All modules depend on shared functionality in `contexter_utils.py` for common operations like file I/O, parsing, and formatting.

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py23-53](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L23-L53)

## Update Strategy Comparisonsvg image

### Standard Diff Approachsvg image

Commands: `updatecontext`, `updatecontexthtml`

The standard approach uses traditional unified diff algorithms:

- Compares context files line-by-line
- Generates patches compatible with standard `patch` library
- Works with any text content
- Universal compatibility

**Implementation**: Uses Python `patch` library for diff generation and application

### Rsync-Based Approachsvg image

Command: `smartupdate` (Markdown only)

The rsync-based approach leverages efficient delta-encoding algorithms:

- Optimized for large files and many changes
- Detects moved/copied content blocks
- Produces smaller patch files
- **Recommended** for production use per [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L29-L29)

**Key Advantage**: Can operate directly on directories or context files, offering flexibility in input sources

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L29-L29) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml28](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L28-L28)

## Patch Generation Commandssvg image

### updatecontextsvg image

**Module**: `update_context.py`  
**Entry Point**: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py43](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L43-L43)  
**Format**: Markdown → Markdown patch

Generates standard unified diff patches by comparing two Markdown context files. Suitable for basic version tracking and manual inspection of changes.

### smartupdatesvg image

**Module**: `smart_update.py`  
**Entry Point**: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py45](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L45-L45)  
**Format**: Markdown → Markdown patch  
**Status**: Recommended

High-performance patch generation using rsync delta-encoding. Produces more efficient patches, especially for large projects or extensive modifications. Can accept directories or context files as input.

### updatecontexthtmlsvg image

**Module**: `update_context_html.py`  
**Entry Point**: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py51](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L51-L51)  
**Format**: HTML → Patch (MD or HTML)

Generates patches from HTML context files. Output patch format can be configured.

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py43-51](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L43-L51) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L29-L29)

## Patch Application Commandssvg image

### updatersvg image

**Module**: `updater.py`  
**Entry Point**: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py44](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L44-L44)  
**Format**: Applies patches to Markdown contexts

Reads a patch file and applies the encoded changes to a target Markdown context file. Produces an updated context file with modifications applied.

### updaterhtmlsvg image

**Module**: `updater_html.py`  
**Entry Point**: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py52](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L52-L52)  
**Format**: Applies patches to HTML contexts

Reads a patch file and applies changes to a target HTML context file. Supports both Markdown-format and HTML-format patches.

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py44-52](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L44-L52)

## Cross-Format Patch Supportsvg image

**Diagram: Cross-Format Patch Application**

The patch system supports cross-format operations:

- Markdown patches can be applied to HTML contexts
- HTML patches can be applied to Markdown contexts

This flexibility enables format-agnostic version control workflows where patch files serve as universal change descriptions independent of the source format.

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md32-33](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L32-L33)

## Common Use Casessvg image

### Version Trackingsvg image

Generate patches between successive project versions to maintain a history of changes:

```px-2
updatecontext project_v1.md project_v2.md > changes_v1_to_v2.patch
```

### Distributed Developmentsvg image

Share incremental updates without transferring entire context files:

```px-2
# Developer A generates patch
smartupdate old_version.md new_version.md > feature_update.patch

# Developer B applies patch
updater project.md feature_update.patch > updated_project.md
```

### Rollback Operationssvg image

Generate reverse patches for undo capabilities by reversing input order:

```px-2
updatecontext new_version.md old_version.md > rollback.patch
```

### CI/CD Integrationsvg image

Automate context updates in build pipelines by generating and applying patches programmatically.

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md27-33](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L27-L33)

## Dependenciessvg image

All update commands rely on the following dependencies:

| Library | Purpose | Used By |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `patch` | Unified diff generation and application | Standard update commands |
| `rsync` (external) | Delta-encoding algorithms | `smartupdate` |

The `patch` library is specified in [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml28](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L28-L28) and provides core diff/patch functionality for standard updates. The `smartupdate` command additionally requires the `rsync` utility to be available on the system path.

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml23-29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L23-L29)

## Implementation Notessvg image

### Module Structuresvg image

Each update command follows the consistent pattern:

1. Parse command-line arguments
2. Read input context files
3. Delegate to `contexter_utils.py` for parsing
4. Perform diff/patch operations
5. Format and write output

### Shared Utilitiessvg image

All update modules utilize functions from `contexter_utils.py` for:

- Context file parsing
- File path extraction
- Content normalization
- Binary file handling
- Output formatting

This shared infrastructure ensures consistent behavior across all update operations and formats.

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py24](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L24-L24) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py23-37](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L23-L37)
